title: The adjoint state method for parametric definable optimization without smoothness or uniqueness
summary: We establish that nonconvex definable parametric optimization problems with possibly nonsmooth objectives, inequality constraints, conic constraint systems, and non-unique primal and dual solutions admit an adjoint state formula under a mere qualification condition. The adjoint construction yields a selection of a conservative field for the value function, providing a computable first-order object without requiring differentiation of the solution mapping. Through examples, we show that even in smooth problems, the formal adjoint construction fails without conservativity or definability,…
